|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Colonel Wullf Yularen (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]; it is the current text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-colonelwullfyularen-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-03-Colonel_Wullf_Yularen.png]]) show the original text (see [[Colonel Wullf Yularen (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Colonel Wullf Yularen (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Imperial Council Member. Agenda: logistics. ISB Agents are forfeit +1. While at Conference Room with Sim Aloo, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from an oponent's just drawn non-Epic Event destiny.” The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> That copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Agenda:” to “Agendas:” and “oponent's” to “opponent's”: “Imperial Council Member. Agendas: logistics. ISB Agents are forfeit +1. While at Conference Room with Sim Aloo, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from an opponent's just drawn non-Epic Event destiny.”<ref name="cl-1240_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
